stories.story_fr: Les revenus totaux du premier trimestre 2026 ont augmenté de 5 % pour atteindre 68,5 milliards de dollars.
stories.story_en: Total revenues for the first quarter 2026 increased 5% to $68.5 billion.
stories.quote: Total revenues for the first quarter 2026 increased 5 % to $68.5 billion

stories.story_fr: Le bénéfice net des actionnaires du premier trimestre 2026 s’élève à 1,7 milliard de dollars, soit 6,26 $ par action.
stories.story_en: Shareholders’ net income for the first quarter 2026 was $1.7 billion, or $6.26 per share.
stories.quote: Shareholders’ net income for first quarter 2026 was $1.7 billion, or $6.26 per share

stories.story_fr: Le revenu ajusté des opérations 1 du premier trimestre 2026 s’élève à 2,1 milliard de dollars, soit 7,79 $ par action.
stories.story_en: Adjusted income from operations 1 for the first quarter 2026 was $2.1 billion, or $7.79 per share.
stories.quote: Adjusted income from operations 1 for the first quarter 2026 was $2.1 billion, or $7.79 per share

stories.story_fr: Le conseil d’administration a augmenté le dividende trimestriel à 1,56 $ par action.
stories.story_en: Board of Directors declared an increase in the quarterly dividend to $1.56 per share.
stories.quote: Board of Directors declared an increase in the quarterly dividend to $1.56 per share

stories.story_fr: Le revenu ajusté des opérations 1 pour l’ensemble de 2025 s’est élevé à 8,0 milliards de dollars, soit 29,84 $ par action.
stories.story_en: Adjusted income from operations 1 for 2025 was $8.0 billion, or $29.84 per share.
stories.quote: Adjusted income from operations 1 for 2025 was $8.0 billion, or $29.84 per share
